description: Namur 3D - Citadelle et ponts is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Namur. Modélisation 3D des ponts LOD2.2, de la passerelle de la gare et de la Citadelle. Les fichiers sont téléchargeables en CityGML et en Sketchup. Les données sont en Lambert 1972 (EPSG 31370). Les données sont consultables directement depuis le site www.le-nid.be (bouton "Namur 3D" en haut à droite). Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Urban planning, Heritage. Its keywords are 3D, Pont, Citadelle, CityGML, Sketchup, scène. The portal shows 2 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2019-02-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
